selection: bounded operational spot-checks from the first 32 rows of each beginning set; positions were retained only when exact per-move score generation completed within a 2-second local cap. This set is deliberately not representative and is reported separately from the deterministic first-64-row calibration corpus.

comparison.interpretation: Pons score is side-to-move relative; compared to IsoMax P0-relative W/D/L after parity/sign conversion

limitations: The 30 positions are deliberately nonrepresentative spot checks selected by an earlier bounded per-move-oracle generation cap.
This result establishes parent-position W/D/L only.
It does not validate the repository-generated per-move score vectors.
It does not establish comparative performance superiority.
